title: Standards query finds the regression-layer record for a regression-test question
body:
Source: t-tpkc9xz trial (b), .krn/runs/research/rss-trials/b-c.md: `krn standards query` missed r-regression-layer on five phrasings of a question about regression tests, though the record exists in .agents/records.json.
Outcome: `krn standards query "what must a regression test for a defect fix look like and where does it go"` (no flags) lists r-regression-layer within the default budget, and so does "regression test defect fix lowest layer".
Proof: a node:test under test/brain runs both queries over the shipped records and asserts the id appears.
